ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to online non-degree, online MCS, online MSME and online MSCEE students. Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. For more details on this course section, please see http://engineering.illinois.edu/online/courses/. Non-Degree students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Program Coordinator, Meg Griffin (mgriffin@illinois.edu).
